test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How many gold medals did India win in the Asian Junior Boxing Championship 2021 in Dubai?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eight**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India won **eight gold, five silver, and six bronze** medals for a total haul of 19 in the junior category.
 
• The prize money for gold, silver, and bronze medallists were $4,000, $2,000, and $1,000, respectively, in the junior category.
 
• The youth boxers added a further six gold, nine silver, and five bronze medals.
 
 
• This is the first time that the continental event is jointly hosting both age groups.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ASBC stands for Asian Boxing Confederation that conducts Boxing championships at various levels.
 
• 2022 ASBC Asian Youth and Junior Boxing Championships were held in Amman, Jordan.
